text:
Rina Gupta: quick usability note from session 7: users skipped the tiny row export icon and expected export in the top toolbar. they didn't discover per-row downloads.
Oliver Park: that's fair. we have global export but per-row is useful for one-offs. what's the current affordance? icon-only, hover tooltip.
Rina Gupta: exact: icon (download) left of kebab, no visible label. contrast on hover isn't great.
A11y QA: icon-only controls need accessible names. aria-label currently 'export' 1 change to 'Download vector (CSV)'. also make focus expose label so keyboard users see text.
Priya Shah: copy: tooltip should say 'Download this vector (CSV)'. global export remains 'Export selected'. avoid mixing 'Download'/'Export' terms across UI.
Oliver Park: proposed implementation: 1) aria-label update; 2) on focus/hover expand to show short label "Download" (width animation), 3) ensure 44px hit target, 4) hover contrast to AA. keyboard focus triggers same expansion.
Rina Gupta: mobile fallback: collapse per-row icon into kebab menu and surface 'Download' as full label.
A11y QA: test matrix: NVDA, VoiceOver iOS, TalkBack. confirm announcement: 'Download vector, button' and that focus order stays: checkbox -> primary -> actions.
DesignBot: Created issue #5060: "Per-row download discoverability + a11y labels + mobile fallback" and assigned to Oliver Park.
Priya Shah: small CSV header nit: include 'source' column (file name) so exported rows remain identifiable.
Oliver Park: will add to spec and mock a focused-label micro interaction. uploading tomorrow. thanks!
